summary: Independent review of feat/f1-latest-gp-0.26.4 (2a66bf1 on main 5a653c7); builder scripts and result files not used (reviewer scripts in scratch review-0264). Page diff: of 26 blocks only dataset, maps, profile-data and the main page script differ; forecasts, historical, tracks, f1-history-2024, f1-predictions-2025, f1-query-history byte-identical; replay/lane/circuit modules byte-identical to main and to f1/release-0.26.3 sources. Dataset: 22 of 25 GP entries byte-identical, 11388/11396/11404 changed scheduled -> completed (11404 also meeting/session date_end 22:00 -> 23:00 UTC as now in OpenF1). Maps: 22 entries identical, 3 new OBSERVED_LOCATION. OpenF1 direct (reviewer fetch 2026-11-02 02:26-02:30 UTC, 25 min after the builder's 02:01:39 collection): Singapore and United States identical row-for-row in all 8 endpoints (drivers, session_result, laps, stints, pit, race_control, weather, position); every map sample of cars 63 and 3 is an exact OpenF1 location row in all 3 GPs. Mexico City: laps/stints/pit/race_control/weather/position identical, but session_result now differs in 11 rows (post-race time penalties: PIA P7->P13 +10 s, COL P8->P15 +10 s, GAS P10->P17 +30 s; LAW, BOR, HAD, HIRAKAWA, ALB, SAI, HUL, PER move up; points change, HIRAKAWA now P10 with 1 point) - the page shows the provisional classification (R1). OpenF1 championship_drivers/teams for 11404 still equal the page (not yet updated for the penalties). Winners/laps/red flags: Singapore VER 62 laps, no red flag, 0 SC; United States ANTONELLI 56 laps, no red flag; Mexico City VER 71 laps, one red flag (RED FLAG 21:06:02 UTC, restart SESSION STARTED 21:45:00, window 3,756.5-6,094.6 s), 2 SC; pit rows 25/32/67. Leakage: the forecasts block is byte-identical to main, to f1/release-0.8.6/index-before.html and to the f1/index.html of commit 0f74498 (2026-10-08 00:22 KST), merged on GitHub as PR #12 at 2026-10-07T15:23:54Z, before all three races; as_of 2026-10-07T02:36:16Z < race starts. Sync (19 completed GPs, new GPs 4,001-4,402 phases): predicted P1 = recorded leader lap progress (both tabs) 0 difference, P1 finish = T, overtakes/backwards 0, all at the line at phase 1, independent hold model = recordedState for all cars; gaps 2 / 2 / 1.4592 s; 16 old GPs identical to main at every sample; 4 upcoming identical. Mexico City: predicted cars do not move during the red flag, but three recorded lap-reconstructed cars (30 LAW, 55 SAI, 50 HIR) creep about 0.88 lap during the suspension because their lap 45 lies wholly inside the window and the hold rule skips it (R2). Browser (Chrome 156, ko/en x 390/1440, Mexico City and Singapore): circuit 1x clock 0.999-1.002 recorded s/s; at 60x the predicted car's pixel advance equals the leader-clock expectation exactly (2.8193 / 2.3458 laps) and is 0.98 of the same driver's recorded GPS advance; lane tab 1x phase 0.01663-0.01670/s, predicted front lane = recorded front lane in every sample; Mexico red flag frames 4,100 s vs 6,000 s: 22 predicted rects identical, 3 of 20 reconstructed rects moved, lanes of 30/50/55 61.67% -> 62.79%. Pre-race forecast note ko/en shown; OCON row '15 / — / 자료 없음(No data) / —'; HIRAKAWA result row team '—', profile page renders without photo, 0 page errors, no horizontal overflow, catalogue completed 19 / cancelled 2 / scheduled 4. check_release PASS; tamper: 11 cases FAIL as intended (old GP, old map, forecasts as_of, historical, new GP back to scheduled, laps emptied, missing log, race order, map status, re-serialisation, state counts); new-GP content, profile-data, dataset extra top-level key, page PreRaceForecasts before-race condition and new-GP date_end are not pinned (R5). Existing protections are not weakened for the 22 untouched entries and the prediction blocks. Tests: test:server 24, build + check-vercel 5, analysis 15, test:report 14 (checks.json reverted), test:odds 877, 0.8.5/0.8.6 check-conditions, 0.8.6 check-history PASS. Legacy checks: check-names, check-tyres (run as scratch copies with Chrome and NODE_PATH) and profiles/check-data (driver count 23->24) pass all other assertions; only the payload-identity step fails and only for maps, dataset, profile-data (R8). Verdict: not merge-ready until R1 is fixed (re-collect Mexico City session_result and later the championship rows, or mark the result as provisional). Manifest must be regenerated after this commit.

issues.description: Mexico City (11404) session_result in the page is the provisional classification collected 2026-11-02 02:01:39 UTC. At 02:27:58 UTC OpenF1 returned a revised classification for 11 drivers after post-race time penalties: PIA P7 (6 pts) -> P13 (0), COL P8 (4) -> P15, GAS P10 (1) -> P17 (+30 s), LAW P9 -> P7 (6 pts), BOR P11 -> P8 (4), HAD P12 -> P9 (2), HIRAKAWA P13 -> P10 (1 pt), ALB, SAI, HUL, PER each up. The result tab, comparison table actual ranks (e.g. LAWSON shown 9), final lane ranks and profile pages show the old order. OpenF1 championship_drivers/teams for 11404 were not yet updated at 02:29 UTC, so standings will change again. Re-collect session_result (and championship rows once updated) before merge, or label the result provisional with the collection time.

redFlagHold skips a lap that starts and ends inside the suspension (moving time 0). In Mexico City lap 45 of cars 30 LAW (3,792.6-6,082.3 s), 55 SAI (3,794.1-6,089.3 s) and 50 HIR (3,808.4-6,091.5 s) lies wholly inside the window 3,756.5-6,094.6 s, so these three lap-reconstructed recorded cars creep ~0.88 lap around the circuit (and 61.67% -> 62.79% in the lane tab) while everything else is held. The 19 held laps behave correctly and the predicted cars do not move. Suggested rule: a lap wholly inside a suspension holds at its start and completes at the restart (or at its recorded end).

HIRAKAWA (50) has no team, colour or photo in the 11404 race drivers row. Display does not break (result team "—", profile without photo, default car colour, 0 errors); in the lane tab his predicted lane has no position and empty status (no pre-race prediction). OpenF1 lists him as "Haas F1 Team" / 9C9FA2 in the same meeting's Practice 1 (11397), Practice 3 (11399) and Qualifying (11400), and in 11308 and 11335; the team and colour can be filled from those sessions with the source recorded.

OCON (31) is in the 2026-10-07 forecast but did not take part in Mexico City. Comparison row shows actual "—", status "자료 없음 / No data", difference "—"; nothing breaks. Wording such as "불참 / Did not take part" would be clearer.

check_release keeps byte identity for the 22 untouched races and maps and for the prediction blocks (tamper confirmed). Not pinned: contents of the 3 added GPs (a swapped winner passes), profile-data (already unpinned before), new top-level dataset keys, the page script condition that the forecast as_of precedes the race start, and changes of the added GP session dates. Acceptable for an added-data release; a hash of the added GP entries recorded in the SPEC would let review detect later drift.

OpenF1 keeps revising data after a race: Mexico classification (R1), session date_end 22:00 -> 23:00 UTC (stored), location rows grew since collection (all stored samples still exact OpenF1 rows), and older GPs' pit/stint values (builder --verify). Record the collection time on screen or re-collect a day after each race.

f1/index.html 23,338,436 B (gzip-6 3,064,911 B; +19.6% over main). Local Chrome: DOMContentLoaded 253-365 ms vs 216-316 ms on main, JS heap 24.1-24.2 MB vs 20.4-20.5 MB (localhost, no throttling). Vercel serves dist/f1/index.html as a static file with compression; no known limit is reached at this size, but this was not checked on a deployment. On a slow mobile link 3 MB still costs several seconds, and each new GP adds ~1.2 MB raw; moving F1 data into separate files (as football did in 0.26.0) is recommended before the season ends.

Confirmed: f1/release-0.9.2/check-names.cjs and f1/release-0.9.3/check-tyres.cjs (the latter also needs Playwright and an Edge path) pass everything except the final payload-identity loop, which reports exactly maps, dataset and profile-data; f1/profiles/check-data.cjs passes all assertions with the driver count changed 23 -> 24. Failures are caused only by the data addition.

rechecks.summary: Reviewer scripts only (scratch review-0264/rc); main work tree not switched; tamper tests ran in an APFS copy-on-write clone (a full git worktree hit 'No space left on device' once, disk 1.9 GB free; clone removed). R1: OpenF1 re-fetched 2026-11-02 02:57-02:58 UTC (after the builder's 02:48:12 collection): Mexico City session_result, laps, pit, race_control, stints, weather, position identical row-for-row to the page; drivers differ only in the filled HIRAKAWA team fields. Result tab shows the revised order (LAWSON 7, BORTOLETO 8, HADJAR 9, HIRAKAWA 10 / 1 pt, ALBON 11, SAINZ 12, PIASTRI 13, HULKENBERG 14, COLAPINTO 15, PEREZ 16, GASLY 17) and the line 'OpenF1 결과 수집: 2026-11-02 02:48 UTC · 경기 뒤 페널티 등으로 바뀔 수 있습니다.' / 'OpenF1 result collected 2026-11-02 02:48 UTC · may change after post-race penalties.' on the 3 new GPs only (Singapore/US 02:01 UTC). Championship: OpenF1 championship_drivers at 02:57 UTC still un-updated for 7 drivers (e.g. PIA 150 vs 144); reviewer recompute points_start + session_result points (no sprint) equals the page for all 24 drivers and 11 teams (driver total = team total = 2,135). Three tied groups (7 pts OCO/ALO/SAI P16-18, 1 pt TSU/HIR P20-21, 0 pts STR/BOT/PER P22-24) are ordered by pre-race position; this equals a countback on 2026 GP finishes for all three groups. The screen shows distinct ranks without saying the standings were recomputed or how ties are ordered (RC-1). R2: lane-comparison source f1/release-0.26.4/comparison.js and circuit source map-comparison.js equal the page modules; laps wholly inside a suspension now hold at their start. Reviewer hold model (own code) = recordedState for every car in 19 GPs; Mexico held laps 22 = module; after the cars reach the pits (3,875.9 s) to the restart (6,094.6 s) predicted movement 0 and recorded movement 0 except three integer steps 44 -> 45 at the recorded lap ends (LAW 6,082.5 s, SAI 6,089.5 s, HIR 6,092.0 s), which do not move the circuit markers (both values are the start line) and move a lane by 1/71 (RC-2). 16 old GPs identical to 0.26.3 (main) at every sample, 4 upcoming identical, P1 = leader 0 difference, no overtakes. R3: HIRAKAWA team Haas F1 Team / 9C9FA2 with team_source listing FP1 11397, FP3 11399, Q 11400; reviewer fetch confirms all three sessions give the same value. R4: OCON shows '불참' / 'Did not take part' in both comparison tables; Singapore OCON (raced) still '완주'. R5: check_release PASS (1,797 files). Tamper (clone, --write-manifest): the 5 cases that passed last time (Mexico winner swap, profile point, dataset top-level key, forecast before-race condition removed, US date_end) and 8 new ones (collected_at, HIRAKAWA team removed, added map sample, maps as_of, summary log append, page-only hold rule change, page-only '불참' label, old GP char) all FAIL with the intended message. Still passing: removing the result-tab 'may change' sentence (page script not pinned) and any data change made together with re-pinning data-pins.json (pins live in the same repository) (RC-3). Tests: test:server 24, build + check-vercel 5, analysis 15, test:report 14 (checks.json reverted), test:odds 877, F1 check-conditions x2 and check-history PASS. Browser (Playwright 1.57, Chrome 156) Mexico City and Singapore ko/en x 390/1440: circuit 1x 0.998-1.001 recorded s/s, lanes 1x front mismatch 0, red-flag frames 4,100 vs 6,000 s: 22 predicted and 20 reconstructed rects identical, lanes unchanged; result note and revised ranks in both languages; HIRAKAWA profile Haas F1 Team, P21, 1 pt; page errors 0; no horizontal overflow; catalogue 19/2/4. f1/index.html 23,346,114 B.

issues.description: Driver/team standings for Mexico City are recomputed (points_start + race points) because OpenF1 had not applied the revised classification; the basis and the tie order (pre-race position, equal to countback here) are stored in profile-data (status recomputed_from_session_result, note) but not shown on screen, where tied drivers get distinct ranks (e.g. TSU P20 and HIR P21 both 1 pt). Suggest a short on-screen note, and re-fetch OpenF1 standings once updated.
Cars 30/55/50 step from lap 44 to 45 at their recorded lap ends 3-12 s before the restart while held. No circuit movement (start line both times); lane tab moves 1/71 of the lane. Acceptable.
